Messages.Author: Andrew S. Davidson
Messages.Body:
On 9 Nov 2001 03:37:08 -0800, arwall wrote:

>here is the cards from the inquest :
>
>The Baron

>Huitzilopochtli

>
>what do you think of them ?

The art is poor. The Baron is the sort of cartoony stuff that sank On
the Edge. Huitzilopochtli is a ludicrous Shy piece - the usual sepia
head with black eyes. No discernable Aztec theme but the guy does
have a pair of fake-looking ram's horns. Echoes of a depressing show
I watched last night called Orcadia. Supposedly a comedy, it showed
two women losers playing a LARP, trying to get a kick from equally
lame guys dressed in horns as Herne the Hunter. A real downer.

WW clearly need to be roasted hard about this otherwise we're going to
get keep getting more of the same. The Lasombra says that no-one with
any influence reads this newsgroup. How can we get this message
across?

Andrew

Messages.Body:
"The Fanboy" <texas...@yahoo.com> wrote in message

> > to gain a master phase if Huitzilopochtli is ready
> >
> >
> > it seems that one must pay one or tap all of his infernal at the
> > beginning of his master phase..
>
> Six superiors? Wow. I'd almost say he alone is worth paying a pool
> each turn for. Hmm...Six possible master phase actions in a turn....

You can only burn pool one time per master phase to gain a master
phase action. Note the text "during" X "you may" Y.

"During phase X, do Y" limits Y to once per phase X. [LSJ 19970625]

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulings.html

You can get 5 total master phase actions now.

One (normal)
Two (Anson or Rumors of Gehenna - not one for each)
Three (The Parthenon)
Four (Sarrasine)
Five (Huitzilopochtli)
